lines.en: I decide to start my day with a trip to the cafe and find Haruka sitting on the couch near the window, going over some paperwork.
lines.zh: 我决定去咖啡馆开启这一天，发现 Haruka 正坐在靠窗的沙发上翻着文件。

lines.en: She flags me over and asks if I want anything before leaving to go get me a cup of black coffee.
lines.zh: 她招呼我过去，问我要喝点什么，然后就离开去给我弄了杯黑咖啡。

lines.en: And considering that she's able to procure one while Rin is working, she really demonstrates her power first thing in the morning and I can't help but be impressed.
lines.zh: 考虑到她是在 Rin 当班的时候弄来的，她一大早就充分展示了自己的权力，我忍不住心生佩服。

lines.en: As it turns out, Haruka is exceptional when it comes to giving people what they actually order.
lines.zh: 事实证明，Haruka 在「按客人实际点的上单」这方面相当出色。

lines.en: That is no small feat based on my experience with Koi Cafe, so I'm really starting to think she actually cares about me.
lines.zh: 以我在 Koi Cafe 的经验来看，这可不是件小事，所以我真的开始觉得她是在意我的。

lines.en: We spend the morning chatting and not paying much attention to things happening around the cafe.
lines.zh: 我们聊了一早上，没怎么留意咖啡馆里发生的事。

lines.en: It's a slow day, so none of her employees seem to mind and, instead, they just let us go on uninterrupted- talking about nothing and sitting a little closer together than we probably should.
lines.zh: 今天生意清淡，所以她的员工们似乎也不介意，反倒由着我们继续——聊些无谓的东西，坐得比该有的距离更近一些。

lines.en: Not all good things last forever, though.
Even though it's slow, it doesn't change the fact that Haruka needs to take inventory so, reluctantly, she ends our little get together and forces me back into the street.
lines.zh: 虽然店里清闲，Haruka 还是得盘库存，所以她不情不愿地结束了我们的小聚，把我赶回了街上。

lines.en: Well, realistically, she doesn't force me anywhere. But it's clear that I've already overstayed my welcome and that I should probably be on my way...
lines.zh: 当然，实际上她也没「赶」我去哪儿。只是很明显我已经待得太久，也该走了……
